name: BlissRisk
structure: CHECK(connected: end | new: INVITE(note x1)(accepted: MSG x2 | not: VIEW > INMAIL))

variants.body: Hi {FIRST_NAME} - {Custom_Message}, I’d love to speak with you about being an advisor to my new risk intelligence startup. I’m confident it will surpass my previous companies - Reachdesk (valued at $225M) & Yieldify (sold to Publicis). Are you free to discuss?

steps.fallback: Hi - Given your impressive experience, I’d love to speak with you about being an advisor to my new risk intelligence startup. I’m confident it will surpass my previous companies - Reachdesk (valued at $225M) & Yieldify (sold to Publicis). Are you free to discuss?

steps.what: opener, advisor ask, credibility, asks for a call

variants.body:
Hey {FIRST_NAME} - Great to be connected! 

As mentioned, I’d love to catch up and share more about the risk intelligence startup I’ve co-founded and explore whether it could be a fit for you to join as a strategic advisor. I believe it has the potential to be bigger than any company I’ve worked on before! 

Are you open to a chat to discuss in more detail?

steps.fallback:
